description:
Found on Voss's body.  Elegant, old-fashioned handwriting:

<color_light_gray>"Aurelio, my darling boy.  The wolf-blood you sent was exquisite.  Send more.  And do finish off the last of that pack in the pines: I won't have dogs howling in my woods.

I am at the old chapel as always.  Visit your mother soon.

- M. S."</color>

His maker.  The one who sent him after your pack.
A ring carved out of yellowed bone and set with a black pearl, taken from the Countess's hand.  The last of the monsters that murdered your pack.
